name: metal-coat
effect: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Steel moves by 20%. Held by Onix or Scyther: Evolves the holder into Steelix or Scizor when traded, respectively.
short_effect: Held: Steel-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.

flavor_text.sun-moon: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a special metallic film that can boost the power of Steel-type moves.
